description: pkix-path-builder/src/lib.rs:248: path.push(candidate.clone()) clones the full Certificate struct (which may be multiple KB for enterprise/gov certs with extensions) on every DFS node push. Iterative deepening re-traverses the same nodes at each depth level, so each cert may be cloned O(depth) times per build. For ITAR/gov PKI with large certs (8+ KB each) and deep hierarchies, this creates significant heap pressure. The fix is to store indices (or references) into the pool rather than cloning certs into the path Vec.
notes: Certificate clone in DFS push is inherent to the Vec<Certificate> ownership model in CertPool. Fixing requires index-based paths instead of owned certs. Out of scope for v0.1.
title: build_path DFS clones full Certificate on every push — excessive alloc for large certs
